result.title: Trade In a Changing World
result.description:
Trade is being reshaped by a more uncertain global economy, as businesses and governments rethink how goods, capital and technology move across borders. From the Middle East to other major trading hubs, maintaining global connectivity increasingly depends on building systems that can absorb disruption without retreating from openness.

What will it take to keep trade open, adaptable and resilient as the rules and routes of the global economy continue to shift?


 
Speakers: Fahad Al Gergawi, Farid Belbouab, Florence Gaub, Paula Hancocks, Timcho Mucunski, Karen E. Young

result.title: Annual Meeting of Global Future Leaders 2026
result.description:
The world is changing fast, so how do we make sure the next generation has the opportunity to shape what comes next?

This week in Dubai, the World Economic Forum hosts the inaugural Annual Meeting of Global Future Leaders 2026. The event is bringing together emerging leaders from across sectors and around the world to explore the opportunities ahead and turn bold ideas into practical action.

Because tomorrow’s leaders aren’t waiting to see what the future will bring. It’s already here.

result.title: Opening Plenary
result.description:
At a time of profound transformation, new technologies, geopolitical uncertainty and shifting models of growth are testing established assumptions about how societies function, economies prosper and institutions operate. 

How can current and next-generation leaders move from foresight to action and work across sectors to shape more resilient, inclusive and collaborative futures?
 
Speakers: Mariam Nourya Koné, Mohammad Abdullah Al Gergawi, Fadel Adib, Sebastian Buckup, Mathieu Flamini, Suhani Jalota, Kiara Winona Sweeney, Alois Zwinggi

result.title: Betazone: The Human-Machine Line
result.description:
Humanoid robots are moving from the demo stage to the shop floor, evolving from curiosities into potential co-workers able to move, sense and decide alongside us.

What would it take for a humanoid to become a genuine collaborator rather than simply another machine?

Join roboticist and designer Madeline Gannon for a visual journey into the emerging world of human-machine collaboration.


 
Speakers: Ambarish Mitra, Dana Alomar, Madeline Gannon

result.title: Trust Test for Agentic AI
result.description:
AI is moving beyond tools that respond to human instruction towards systems capable of acting with greater autonomy. As agentic AI enters public services and business operations, it could significantly expand human capability and value creation but only if its actions can be governed in ways that preserve accountability, judgment and trust.

How do we build trust and governance frameworks that allow agentic AI to move from promise to value while preserving human judgment?


 
Speakers: Yalda Aoukar, Lubna Bouza, Mark-Alexandre Doumba, Omar Sultan Al Olama
